name: Supine Spinal Twist Stretch
instructions: Lie on your back with arms out in a T position.
Bend one knee and let it fall across your body to the opposite side.
Keep both shoulders on the floor and breathe deeply.
Hold 30-60 seconds per side. A classic thoracic and lumbar mobility stretch.
longevityNotes: A stable trunk protects the spine through every decade. Train the core for endurance and control rather than chasing burn.
overview: Supine Spinal Twist Stretch is a beginner core exercise targeting the other, performed with just your bodyweight. A strong trunk stabilizes every lift and protects the spine in daily life.
